mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% and rises by at least 0.10 percentage points over three months, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and 3-month change > 0.10pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of months when UNRATE > 5.5% and UNRATE declines by at least 0.10 percentage points from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 45% of months where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% annually, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (year-over-year).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a monetary policy response to inflation, typically leading to positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days as markets price in the adjustment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 40% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10pp and CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.20pp from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), a decline in industrial production indicates deteriorating supply conditions that reduce corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 55% of months when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% (year-over-year).
